name: Moderate background noise helps creative work

direction.note: Keep the level near 70 dB; at 85 dB the effect turns negative.

claim: Ambient noise at about 70 dB raised creative performance compared with 50 dB, and 85 dB lowered it.
caveat: It measures creative cognition, not a named emotion; the levels are lab playback, and the benefit stops above 70 dB.

sources.title: Mehta, Zhu and Cheema 2012, Is noise always bad? Exploring the effects of ambient noise on creative cognition, Journal of Consumer Research 39(4)
